verdict.rationale: The evidence never describes a cookieless mode or first-party-only storage. The only route to cookie-free tracking is sending events from your own server to the HTTP V2 endpoint, which is a workaround rather than a documented privacy feature. A shared consent model across SDKs is mentioned, which suggests consent handling is expected rather than avoided. Missing for 10: documented cookieless or no-third-party-cookie browser tracking, guidance on reducing consent-banner requirements, details on what the client SDKs store, and independent corroboration.
